The following events happened in '''2975 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]] develops a fleet of [[Airship/Legends|airships]] which allows the Tribe to reach Alanciar.<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*The [[Alanciari]] woman [[Quarra Thayn]] begins an affair with [[Jogan Halder]].<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*Alanciari Keshiri destroy Vrai's scouting part of three airships.
*Vrai coerces Quarra Thayn into serving as his guide for a reconnaissance mission to [[Sus'mintri]], Alanciar's military capital.<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*Alanciari Keshiri destroy [[High Lord]] [[Korsin Bentado]]'s [[Ebon Fleet]].<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*Lord Bentado and the survivors of the Ebon Fleet assassinate the entire Alanciari [[War Cabinet]].<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*Lord Bentado attempts to create a "Second Tribe" on Alanciar but is stopped by Vrai, Thayn, and [[Squab (Keshiri)|Squab]].<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] annexes [[Alanciar]] with minimal hostilities.<ref name="Pandemonium" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[John Jackson Miller]] has indicated that the events of ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]'' occur approximately one year prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral|''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral'']].<ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith – Spiral #1">{{Faraway|url=comics/swlosttribeofthesithspiral/swlosttribeofthesithspiral1.html|text=''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith &ndash; Spiral'' #1}}</ref>
